`records-v1.bin` is a 200-byte save encoded independently of the current game:
magic 0x4752564c, version 1, car 2, track 1, with Kestrel GT/Bracken cumulative times
18/36/54/74/92 seconds and all other pairs empty. Words are little-endian; the
final word is the original FNV-1a checksum of the preceding 196 bytes. It verifies
migration of actual old-format bytes, including global unlock credit.

`best-records-v4.bin` and `best-ghost-v1.bin` are a matching Finch/Bracken Ridge
record and replay generated by `build/replay_fixtures <output-directory>`. The
fixture uses the public deterministic driving controls and is used for browser
reload/corruption checks. The same tool also produces an ignored flash workload
fixture: its poses are deliberately moved two nodes ahead so ghost fading cannot
remove the rendering cost. That synthetic workload is not a player record.

`finch-driving-inputs.bin` is the same Finch run as one public-control bitmask
per 20ms frame (left=1, right=2, throttle=4, brake=8). The browser regression
feeds these as keyboard events with a controlled animation clock, completes a
new best through normal gameplay, then verifies IndexedDB persistence and reload.
No position, timer, finish flag or game record is edited to complete that race.
